PROJECT_STATUS.md, MEMORY.md, AGENTS.md, README.md, TECH_STACK.md and SKILLS.md were brought to 3.7.0: version and build id, the third surface and its separate record, the per-surface control list, the resume rules, the universal Stop, DB v5, the new files, a new Applicant collector specialist agent, and the note that 3.7.0 requested no new permission.
